statement: Pi RPC mode accepts typed commands as LF-delimited JSON on stdin and emits responses plus agent events as LF-delimited JSON on stdout, including controls for prompting, steering, sessions, compaction, retry, models, and tools.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi RPC mode 通过 stdin 接收 LF 分隔的类型化 JSON command，并通过 stdout 输出 LF 分隔的 response 与 agent event；协议覆盖 prompt、steering、session、compaction、retry、model 与 tool 控制。
display_text.en: Pi RPC mode accepts typed commands as LF-delimited JSON on stdin and emits responses plus agent events as LF-delimited JSON on stdout, including controls for prompting, steering, sessions, compaction, retry, models, and tools.

evidence.title: Pi RPC mode implementation
evidence.locator: RPC command dispatch and JSONL output

notes: Framing and command coverage are source-backed; cross-language client interoperability has not been reproduced.
